comment: §10.27 / §10.63 R5 — minimal resident core classification. Only resident-core components start at boot; on-demand components are activated by their listed trigger and may be unloaded when idle. Scheduled components ride the shared PeriodicScheduler. Missing/unknown components default to resident-core (status quo, fail-safe).

ipc_server.rationale: command routing / UI channel (§10.27 minimal set)

governance_gates.rationale: permission gates / capability verification (§10.27 minimal set)

periodic_scheduler.rationale: single deadline-driven loop; hosts coordinator / idle-memory / daily-cleaner / git sweep+sync jobs (R3 consolidation)

core_sovereigns.rationale: decision / maintenance / permission / system-runtime — codex-required resident governance

maintenance_controller.rationale: bounded basic health monitoring (§10.27 minimal set); 30s tick

hot_reload_watcher.activation: app:hot-reload-backend command / governed update path (update_manager, confirmation service) call _maybe_reload directly
hot_reload_watcher.rationale: §10.27 lists 熱重載 as on-demand; the filesystem poll loop is the resident cost, the governed reload capability stays available without it
